_doc: Footprint ANCHOR positions in board-relative mm (outline origin top-left, 140x110), [x, y, rot]. Applied by tools/apply_placement.py.
_plan: ESP32 rotated 270: audio socket row on top (3V3 at the right end, 5V at the left end), control row at the bottom. DIR9001 socket on the right with the 33 R column; the five DIR nets fan onto the right end of the top row, the four DAC nets sit next to them and go left. DACs on the left with header columns facing the ESP32 and output pads facing the edge terminals. Power top-left, DIR supply filter next to the DIR socket, controls on the bottom edge.
